description: v3 generic-packager cross-benchmark pilot. Tests whether GENERIC packagers (no v1 cache, no benchmark vocabulary) avoid the SIEVE-v1 ConvoMem collapse. Conditions: raw uncapped, raw@400, filtered_raw@400, extractive@400, summary@400, structured_generic@400, guarded_structured@400 on 100-query ConvoMem + HotpotQA slices. See research/v3-learned-compiler-proposal-2026-07.md ('$3-5 generic-packager pilot').

slices.comment: Both pilot slices are schema-compatible with the v2 runner (example_id, query, candidate_memories[{memory_id, content}], question_date). HotpotQA rows have question_date=None and no date-prefixed content.

evaluation_split.comment: Pilot uses a 100-query slice per benchmark (--limit 100). Budget 0 denotes the uncapped raw control.

filtered_raw.comment: Keep turns whose relevance >= relative_threshold * max_relevance.

extractive.comment: Sentence-level extraction; top sentences by relevance, source chronology.

structured_generic.comment: No tunable params; MIN_EVIDENCE_TOKENS floor is a module constant.

guarded_structured.comment: No tunable params; COVERAGE_MIN_FRACTION guard threshold is a module constant.

summary.comment: Abstractive summary via injected compile-LLM; needs --compile-model at compile time.

reader_panel.comment: Pilot readers: 2-3 weak/mid open readers. Frontier IDs added in a run-specific override before unseen-reader claims.

judge.comment: Judge held constant with the published paper for comparability (deepseek-chat-v3, GPT-4o cross-check kappa 0.89-0.92). Do NOT swap for a local judge without flagging comparability loss.

compile_model.comment: Compile-LLM for the summary style only. Never used in tests or offline smoke runs.
